authority: PROMPT PR3 v1.2.1 + A02/A02A/A03/A05 v1.2/A06 v1.2/A07 v1.1 + exact promoted profiles
scope: P1 technical binding: UI↔API/BFF↔ExecutionService↔promoted B0/B0.5/B1/B2. Does not deploy P2 persistence, P3 GPT/evaluator, or P4 UI connection.
invariants: UI_IS_PROJECTION: browser renders server-approved InteractionContract and returns values by opaque slot_ref; it never computes next, branching, causal activation, readiness, evidence state, AI mode or handoff.
NEXT_STAGE_NO_INVENTION: every transport field and block-specific adapter target is declared here or explicitly marked as an infrastructure non-decision.
ONE_AUTHORITATIVE_STATE_PLANE: logical writes target A06 only; physical PostgreSQL/Supabase topology remains P2.
B0.5 and B1 produce zero generative model calls.
B2 AI invocation and evaluator/admission are server-side internal operations; UI never calls provider/evaluator endpoints directly.
A05 release, receipt and consumption remain separate events; ExecutionService alone advances A03 chain state.
A07 idempotency governs command replay/conflict; browser never supplies an authoritative idempotency_key.
Raw literal/value is preserved before normalization; UNKNOWN != FALSE and CANDIDATE != EVIDENCE.

routes.rule: token_request_id is an opaque NON_SEMANTIC/NON_AUTHORITY transport nonce. Same token_request_id+same bound payload returns the same client_event_id/action_token; different payload conflicts. A06 CommandReceipt is written atomically with token allocation.
No semantic/control write. Same authoritative state revision yields the same projection content hash/ETag; no CommandReceipt is created merely to make a read idempotent.

authentication_boundary.logical_requirement: BFF resolves authenticated principal and authorized Case/Participant/Role/Activity scope before ExecutionService.

action_token_contract.token_request_id: Caller/SDK generates one opaque random nonce per deliberate token request and reuses it on transport retry. It is NON_SEMANTIC/NON_AUTHORITY and exists only to make token issuance idempotent before client_event_id exists.
action_token_contract.client_event_id_generation: BFF allocates once only after accepting ISSUE_ACTION_TOKEN command; replay returns the original allocation.
action_token_contract.retry: caller reuses same token_request_id for ISSUE_ACTION_TOKEN retry; after issuance, reuses same client_event_id + action_token for command retry.
action_token_contract.tamper_rule: mismatch between token binding and request operation/scope/interaction => fail closed before semantic state write
action_token_contract.A07_binding: BFF/ExecutionService derives CommandReceipt identity/idempotency_key from operation + server-resolved command_scope_ref + command_event_id. UI cannot choose idempotency_key or domain identity.
action_token_contract.receipt_rule: ISSUE_ACTION_TOKEN is itself receipt-bound. OPEN_OR_RESUME and RESUME are receipt-bound before any downstream allocation/render side effect.

option_contract.internal_bff: option_ref -> exact canonical local-runtime value/list member
option_contract.rule: UI never translates label/id into methodological meaning. Option refs are server-issued for the current slot/context revision.

slot_ref_profile.name: EVE-PR3-SLOT-REF-v1
slot_ref_profile.purpose: opaque transport identity; not a new methodological/canonical variable identity

response_command_contract.resolution: BFF resolves slot_ref through server-side SlotBindingRegistry fixed at presentation time; stale/unknown slot_ref or context_revision => REENTRY_REQUIRED/fail closed.
response_command_contract.batch_atomicity: All answer items of one SUBMIT_RESPONSE command are one authoritative logical transaction. Any validation/idempotency conflict prevents partial semantic commit. P2 must implement this atomic boundary regardless of physical table layout.
response_command_contract.local_runtime_idempotency_adapter: For a multi-answer command, each promoted local runtime call receives a deterministic child key local-<first24(SHA256(parent A07 idempotency_key + LF + slot_ref + LF + expected response revision))>. Child key is adapter-only and does not replace the authoritative A07 command identity.
response_command_contract.correction: SUBMIT_CORRECTION requires a newly issued client_event_id; each correction item includes slot_ref, raw_value, raw_literal?, knowledge_basis?, supersedes_response_key, expected_response_revision. BFF verifies prior response belongs to same chain/object/slot and uses next revision only.

execution_service_contract.next_authority: ExecutionService resolves next object/interaction from promoted Runtime result + A03 dependency state + A05 consumer readiness. UI has no next authority.
execution_service_contract.runtime_adapter_rule: Reference runtimes may be wrapped/transduced, but production adapter must preserve their promoted semantic/profile behavior and cannot retain SQLite as authoritative state.
execution_service_contract.handoff_rule: On object closure, build exact A05 MaterialPackage, write RELEASE; initialize/resolve consumer ObjectRun; write RECEIPT; only after consumer accepts exact package write CONSUMPTION. No single event substitutes another.
execution_service_contract.transaction_boundary: Command semantic commit and its audit/budget/handoff consequences are all-or-nothing at A06 logical level; provider AI calls may be external but admission/state commit remains transactional/idempotent.

logical_persistence_binding.rule: A04 references A06 v1.3 logical record/field names only. Every side-effecting command is CommandReceipt-bound. No route, adapter or UI component may import a legacy Supabase table name as a production dependency.

read_only_operation_equivalent.READ_STATE: No CommandReceipt because there is no write. Idempotency is demonstrated by pure-read semantics + authoritative projection revision/content hash.

B2.fallback_rule: Per-node fallback_profile_ref and runtime_display_contract are authoritative. K2 HOLD profiles cannot be replaced by static canonical prompt when model/review unavailable.

implementation_gate_binding.A04_effective_readiness_rule: Treat the four named implementation blockers as resolved only when the exact overlay artifact/hash is loaded and its runtime acceptance fixtures pass. All other promoted-profile restrictions remain active.
implementation_gate_binding.never: Do not rewrite implementation_ready=true into promoted profile bytes.

execution_result_contract.no_ui_next_field: There is no client-authoritative next_runtime_id or next_object_key input.
execution_result_contract.receipt_state_semantics: Persisted immutable primary receipt stores ACCEPTED or REJECTED_PRECONDITION. Replay/conflict are response projection states referencing the original receipt; they do not mutate it.

reentry_resume_contract.stale_context: If request context_revision is not current, no semantic write; return current context revision and authoritative turn/reentry descriptor.
reentry_resume_contract.disconnect_resume: RESUME is A07 CommandReceipt-bound before rendering. Same command identity+payload returns same receipt/result and cannot duplicate charge/presentation. A new PresentationEvent is permitted only for a genuinely new authorized render/reentry transition and must be listed in side_effect_refs.
reentry_resume_contract.causal_reentry: Defect returns to causal owner per A03/A05/A06; only dependent set invalidated. Browser receives a turn; it does not choose reentry target.

closure.P4_note: Actual UI route/component connection remains P4; P4 must implement this A04 contract without semantic decisions.

command_receipt_protocol.atomic_commit: First execution commits CommandReceipt with all side_effect_refs in the same logical transaction/boundary; retry returns the persisted result and creates zero new side effects.
command_receipt_protocol.conflict: same idempotency_key + different payload_sha256 => IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; original receipt and side effects remain immutable.
command_receipt_protocol.open_or_resume: scope/event key exists before chain_run_id, object_run_id or interaction_key are allocated; replay returns exact allocated identifiers.
command_receipt_protocol.resume: receipt exists before any re-render/reentry side effect; replay cannot duplicate PresentationEvent or charge.
command_receipt_protocol.correction: new client_event_id/command_event_id + new response revision + supersedes; no overwrite.
